m1.typescript: m1 the prompt puts criteria first then examples then the diff last

e1.typescript: e1 vague criteria are refused in both the report and the skip text

e2.typescript: e2 a criterion needs report skip and a concrete severity example for high and low

e3.typescript: e3 two to four examples with a report and a skip each carrying a reason

e4.typescript: e4 a category with enough reviews and low precision is disabled

e5.typescript: e5 the most dismissed patterns are listed by count then name and capped at three

e6.typescript: e6 an attended run asks only what it cannot assume and states its assumptions

e7.typescript: e7 an unattended run never asks it states assumptions or stops

wrong-diff-first.defect: puts the diff before the criteria

wrong-vague-report-only.defect: checks the report text for vague phrases and not the skip text

wrong-vague-short-list.defect: leaves be conservative out of the vague phrases

wrong-skip-blank.defect: accepts a blank report or skip text

wrong-severity-high-only.defect: asks for a high severity example and not for a low one

wrong-all-report-examples.defect: accepts a set of examples that are all reports

wrong-reason-optional.defect: accepts an example whose reason is blank

wrong-unknown-category.defect: accepts a report example for a category that is not a criterion

wrong-disable-few.defect: disables a category on too few reviews

wrong-precision-inverted.defect: computes the share dismissed and calls it precision

wrong-boundary-disables.defect: disables a category whose precision is exactly the limit

wrong-top-by-name.defect: lists dismissed patterns by name and not by count

wrong-counts-accepted.defect: counts the patterns of accepted findings as dismissed

wrong-ask-defaults.defect: asks for fields that have a default

wrong-unattended-asks.defect: asks a question in a run that nobody attends

wrong-unattended-guess.defect: proceeds in an unattended run without a value that has no default

wrong-blank-is-present.defect: treats a field that holds only spaces as given
